Name: Less is More - An Item Bags Config File
Author: SquidlyJesus
Description:
Less is More combines most bags together and removes several redundancies. This makes the mod MUCH easier and faster to use, and less confusing.
There are now only 7 type of bags, other than the Omni, Bundle, and Rucksack bags which are unchanged.

[size=4]Bag Changes[/size]

[size=3]All Bags[/size]
Completely removed redundancies, with two exceptions. I couldn't decide if Grapes and Cactus should be in Crops or Foraging, so I left them in both.
Removed all food from all bags except the food bag.
Removed all redundant bags.
All bags have modifications for all sizes: Small, Medium, Large, Giant, and Massive, though I'll mostly be covering the Massive sized bags in the details below.

[size=3]Mining Bag[/size]
Combines Gem, Smithing, Mineral, Mining, and Loot Bags.
Doesn't have certain items, like stone, but it does have all "geodes", including Mystery Boxes and Golden Mystery Boxes.

[size=3]Resource Bag[/size]
Combines Resource, Construction, and Farmer's Bags.

[size=3]Animal Products Bag[/size]
Basically unchanged. Couldn't really do much with this.

[size=3]Foraging Bag[/size]
Combines Foraging and Artifacts Bags.
Also removes some shellfish that are redundant from the Fishing Bag.
Removed the Dinosaur Egg since that fits better into Animal Products.

[size=3]Fishing Bag[/size]
Combines the Recycling and Fishing Bags.

[size=3]Food Bag[/size]
Moved the quality products into the quality section, removed Maple Syrup since it's in the Crops Bag, and added the Preserves Jar. Otherwise mostly unchanged.

[size=3]Crops Bag[/size]
Combines the Tree, Seed, and Crops Bags.

[size=4]Installing[/size]

Manually install it by placing the file in the "ItemBags" folder.
If using Vortex simply have it load after the Item Bags mod.

After installing consider changing the Omni Bag Menu Columns settings. You'll need to edit the config.json file directly, and change it for every Omni Bag size, but it's up to you what you change it to. You can find Omni Bag settings past line 119, starting with: "OmniBagSettings": [

If you're installing on a fresh save, no problem! If you're doing an existing save make sure you empty out all your bags, including removing all bags from your Omni Bag first. You should be able to load the game afterward, then simply trash any bugged bags.
